title: Azulejos
description: The blue-and-white glazed ceramic tiles of Spain and Portugal, generated procedurally. Each tile carries an 8-fold rosette with diagonal stems linking to corner buds so the motif runs continuously across the wall, framed by a painted border and set in grout. Cobalt on cream, polychrome Spanish (blue, ochre and terracotta) or manganese purple; a soft glaze sheen sweeps across the fired surface and the mic nudges its brightness. Tiles across, rosette points, ornament, grout and motif drift are live.
